site.name: Green Lotus Golf Club
site.description: Book a tee time online at Green Lotus Golf Club, an 18-hole course on Highway 51 near Ho Chi Minh City.

hero.headline: Book your tee time at Green Lotus
hero.sub: Open times every 10 minutes from 5:30. Pick a time, 9 or 18 holes, up to 4 players, and pay online.

home.title: Green Lotus Golf Club — book a tee time
home.description: Today's open tee times at Green Lotus Golf Club, every 10 minutes from 5:30, with the green fee for weekday and weekend.

course.headline: 18 holes along the Đồng Nai lowlands
course.body: A par-72 course an hour from Ho Chi Minh City, with wide fairways, water on the back nine, and a clubhouse open from 5:30 to 18:00 every day.

teeTimes.headline: Open tee times
teeTimes.sub: Every 10 minutes from 5:30. Green fee shown per player.
teeTimes.empty: No open tee times left for today.

items.title: Pay online
items.body: Visa and Mastercard, confirmed the moment you pay.

items.title: Instant confirmation
items.body: Your tee time is held the moment payment clears.

items.title: 1 to 4 players
items.body: Book for yourself or your whole group in one booking.

teeTime.title: Book this tee time
teeTime.description: Pick the date, the time, 9 or 18 holes and your players, then pay online by card.
teeTime.signInFirst: Sign in to book this tee time

checkout.title: Pay for your tee time
checkout.description: Pay online by Visa or Mastercard to confirm your tee time at Green Lotus Golf Club.
checkout.secureNote: Payments are encrypted. Green Lotus never stores your card number.

confirmation.title: Booking confirmed
confirmation.description: Your tee time at Green Lotus Golf Club is confirmed.
confirmation.headline: Your tee time is booked
confirmation.sub: A confirmation has been saved to your bookings. See you on the first tee.
